MIDGROUND: at the left an open shopfront of a small cafe, a plain indigo noren cloth hanging in its doorway, inside a wooden service counter with shelves of blank ceramic bowls, blank jars and three plain bottles whose labels are empty pale rectangles with no writing; at the right the timber wall and shuttered window of the neighbouring house, a low bench, stacked wooden crates and a tub of potted plants outside.
